title: Press kit
intro: Media resources for {appName} — the offline-first Muslim worship companion.

boilerplate.heading: Boilerplate
boilerplate.body: {appName} — {tagline} Available on iOS, Android, and web. Free for personal and educational use with no ads. The project is source-available on GitHub under the {license} (non-commercial; attribution required). Features include Salah tracking with a focus lock, a Qaza calculator and planner, adhkar and tasbeeh, the offline Qur'an with on-device recitation practice, a hadith library, a Masjid finder, family and kids mode, group khatm, widgets and watch companions, 24 languages, and optional sync, plus a learning library and step-by-step worship guides.

items.app: App display & UI: Spline Sans · App headlines: Lora (serif accent)
items.website: Website: Plus Jakarta Sans (headings) and Inter (body)
items.arabic: Arabic content in-app: Amiri, Scheherazade New, Noto Naskh Arabic, QPC Hafs (user-selectable)

logo.heading: Logo
logo.usage: Use the official Munib app icon with sufficient contrast. Do not stretch, rotate, or recolor the mark. Minimum clear space: one-quarter of the icon width on all sides.

screenshots.heading: Screenshots
screenshots.body: Screenshots of the app appear on each <features>feature page</features>. For full-resolution files, use the <contact>contact form</contact> with your publication name and deadline.
screenshots.gallery: Every image below is a real capture of {appName} on that device, in this page's language where the app has it. Download any of them for your coverage.

pressContact.heading: Press contact
pressContact.body: For interviews, review units, or partnership inquiries, use our <contact>contact form</contact> and mention that your message is a press enquiry.
